purpose: Search declared freeform geometry and character-performance controls against explicit measurements, then retain verified construction and reusable settings.

properties.path: new output directory outside the protected live machine body
properties.search: axm.construction-search/v0.1: intent, recipe, controls, criteria, budget; optional motion_probe and warm_starts

contains: search.json with contract, trials, measurements and stop reason
accepted winner.glb and retained creator source when criteria pass
reusable settings and semantic construction signature

limitations: Intent is made executable by caller-declared controls and criteria; prose is not silently interpreted as an aesthetic score.
Finite best-first search, bounded candidate and validation counts, same-runtime deterministic order. No global optimality or statistical-confidence claim.
Runtime pose sampling measures geometry, deformation and declared flat support contacts; no dynamics, self-intersection or unsampled-extrema guarantee.
Verified construction is retained as a candidate. Existing growth acceptance and semantic deduplication still govern reusable-library admission.
